hypotheses.claim: The test locates an article/status before the actual navigation button is enabled; click is discarded. Final failure DOM may show later ready state.
hypotheses.prediction: At the single click, disabled=true; inspect=0/open=0. Holding real initial journal load until immediately after click reproduces the unchanged navigation assertion.

hypotheses.claim: A pending navigation epoch effect from initial owner/closeSafe transition invalidates inspect after the click.
hypotheses.prediction: Click enabled=true and inspect starts/finishes; no callback despite current owner and policy. Explicit stable readiness completion before click eliminates this controlled case.

hypotheses.claim: An external access/owner change intentionally invalidates pending navigation.
hypotheses.prediction: Captured access generation/context differs before inspect resolves, or effect dependency changes; merely waiting the original button cannot override the protection.

hypotheses.claim: The fixture response is rejected or inspection never finishes.
hypotheses.prediction: Inspect rejects/hangs or validation alert persists, instead of a silent pre-click readiness mismatch.

scope: Ranked before any local execution of this failure. Static and CI DOM observations do not prove original CI cause. Controlled cases use actual component/hooks and fake-indexeddb application-port fixtures, not browser/API verification.
plan: Run original single case once unchanged.
Use bounded controlled actual journal load/list delivery and click-time observer without changing the original post-click assertion.
Only if proved, synchronize actionable button in owned test; preserve original assertion timeout and application safeguards.
